rule: a part is fixed when it is locked, on B.Cu, or its reference class is J, H, TP or SW (connectors, holes, test pads, switches stay where the template has them)

explicit.why: port 1 charger inductor: tall part, the cup was checked against its position (groundup README: L401/L501 unchanged so the board drops into the same cup)
port 2 charger inductor: same as L401
BLE module: antenna position against the cup wall
wire pad / Tag-Connect footprint: holes go through the board, cup side checked (J* would be fixed by the rule anyway)
Tag-Connect programming footprint: holes through the board, cup side checked
antenna matching network of U301: tuned with the module position
BLE module decoupling, kept next to the fixed module
BLE module support part kept next to the fixed module
